pages.title: Chemical Plant Zone
pages.text: Chemical Plant Zone is the second level of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (Sega, 1992). VGMPF lists its tune at just over two minutes.

pages.title: A convincing slap bass
pages.text: In the Sonic Stadium Soundtrack Squad Review of 2010, the reviewer T-BIRD praised Chemical Plant Zone for "an incredibly convincing slap-bass synthesised by Nakamura-san", meaning the composer Masato Nakamura. JezMM and Extaticus both named it their favorite tune on the Genesis version.

pages.title: Back in 2017
pages.text: Sega Retro lists Masato Nakamura's music for Chemical Plant Zone among his credits in Sonic Mania (2017), a new game that brought the old zone back.
